series.title: AI foundations
series.lede: From how the AI you use every day actually works, through machine learning, to deep learning. No prerequisites: each workshop builds on the one before, and all years are welcome.

modules.blurb: What AI is and is not, the kinds of systems behind the tools you already use, and the map for the rest of the series.
Agents: models that plan, call tools and carry a task through, and what that means for how you build with them.

modules.title: Machine learning
modules.blurb: Teaching a model a rule from data instead of writing the rule yourself: training, testing, and the metrics that tell you whether it worked.

modules.title: Deep learning
modules.blurb: Neural networks: how layers of simple units learn from images and text, and training your first one.

series.title: Building with AI
series.lede: Five sessions from first principles to working code: what today's models are, how to work with them, and two hands-on builds with the code to take home.

series.title: AI in practice
series.lede: The fundamentals, a neural network built by hand, and AI APIs in a real project.

series.title: Language and attention
series.lede: Natural language processing and the attention mechanism, worked through real examples.

series.title: Machine learning, step by step
series.lede: Scientific Python, then regression, classification and feature engineering, then neural networks. Every session has its notebook on Kaggle and most have a recording.

series.title: Data science fundamentals
series.lede: The club's first full series, run online and recorded: Python and data science from a first Kaggle submission to clustering and dimensionality reduction.

standalone.title: One-off workshops
standalone.lede: Sessions run at hackathons and on their own, outside a series.
